changes.title: Recorded singer
items: The music's singer is now a real recorded voice singing "laa" and "loo", drifting through a long, shimmering reverb

changes.title: Island shapes
items: Islands grow out from home with arms, bays and peninsulas, more irregular the further out their phase (home stays near-round)
Try a phase's shape with ?phase=1 to ?phase=5

changes.title: Hats brooms
items: Hats and brooms with spells: pick them in your room's Hat and Broom boxes
The plain broom lets you rise to the treetops again sooner; Speed is now a broom of its own
Long broom: blinks go twice as far. Double blink broom: one more blink
Helmet: takes a hit for you and falls off; pick it up to wear it again
Healing ring hat: put it down and stand by it to heal
